changes_vs_seed: 题干：只替换时间表达，其余与原题一字不差

step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's revenue per employee for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Report in US dollars rounded to the nearest dollar.
step5_question.gt_template:
Revenue per Employee is Net Sales divided by the number of employees. For 2026:

Number of Employees = [[Emp@FY2026]]
Revenue per Employee = $[[Rev@FY2026]] million / [[Emp@FY2026]] = $[[RevPerEmp@FY2026]]
For 2025:

Number of Employees = [[Emp@FY2025]]
Revenue per Employee = $[[Rev@FY2025]] million / [[Emp@FY2025]] = $[[RevPerEmp@FY2025]]
Revenue per employee [[!RevPerEmp_change]] from $[[RevPerEmp@FY2025]] in 2025 to $[[RevPerEmp@FY2026]] in 2026, as net sales grew while headcount fell (P&G reported approximately [[Emp@FY2026]] employees at June 30, 2026, a decrease of 4% versus the prior year).
